definitions.generated: Candidate appearances at semantic planning calls; not unique jobs or task quotas.
definitions.selected: Selected approaches; may repeat while travel/reservation is pending.
definitions.executed: Task-linked semantic attempt events, not unique successes.
definitions.attemptedTasks: Unique tasks with an actual conversation execution receipt.
definitions.reportedTasks: Tasks with a spoken report; a report is not proof of successful work.
definitions.ballotIntentAgreement: Diagnostic agreement with persistent intention after Tribal; certified resolver may legally adapt at Tribal.
definitions.majorityOutcomes: Actual initial Tribal tally has a strict majority; not an omniscient NPC belief.
definitions.repeatedAgenda: Repeated selection of the same work key; includes normal continuing travel.
definitions.maxQueue: Camp-wide unresolved task records, not one contestant issuing all those requests.
definitions.restoreMs: Total synchronous restore time in paired replay runs; includes snapshot checks.
definitions.style: Observed production cast behavior in differing circumstances, not a matched-pair personality experiment.
